<div class="card-body">
'''LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay)''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">LIN-V8K（エルアイン・ヴィーエイトケイ）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">地雷を敷設できる。また、ターン中の好きな時に、１フォース消費して同じ位置カードにある地雷を１つ“無効化”（ロスト）させられる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-LIN-V8K-Elleyein-Veeatekay-SWCA-100706.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">代表的な地雷敷設／爆破用装甲ドロイド。軍事目的に転用された。地雷や爆薬を仕掛けたり除去したりする。このＬＩＮ－Ｖ８Ｋはジャワに再改造されたもの。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay).

'''Card text:'''
May lay mines. Also, at any time during a turn, may use 1 Force to “defuse” (lose) one mine at the same location card.

'''Lore:'''
A typical armored droid for laying mines and demolition, converted for military use. It plants and removes mines and explosives. This LIN-V8K was modified again by Jawas.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore is the Jawa-refurbished text; the English original wiki page shows generic mining-droid lore.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay)]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
